description: API-Bank style (tool use against a documented API): write a client from API.md for a local HTTP service that the Node test starts in-process. Needs cursor pagination with URL-encoding of opaque cursors, 429 handling that honours Retry-After (or exponential backoff without it) up to five attempts, 5xx retries limited to idempotent GETs with a retry cap, no retry on POST 5xx or other 4xx, 404 mapped to null and structured errors. Delays are checked through an injected fake sleep.
